race.comment: HORSESHOE HILL (8) is a talented mare back from a 172-day spell. Finished just 2.5 lengths behind Beadman first-up in the Listed Fireball last prep. Bjorn Baker has found a softer race to launch this campaign. Has her share of weight but has the class to dispose of this field. VALILEE (7) led but found one better when fresh from a 45-day let-up over 900m at Newcastle last time out. Strips fitter and performs best over 1000m, with two wins from four attempts. Sure to take some catching. SPARTUS (1) tackled a $150k BM100 here at this trip recently and wasn't beaten all that far. Nicely in after Grima's claim in this far more suitable assignment. BRUCE I AM (11) didn't show his customary speed but closed well to grab second when resuming over 1100m here last start. Lightly raced gelding who scored at his only other 1000m run. Honest mare CONFIDENTIALITY (10) should be there at business end at her first run back from a five-month lay-off.
